text:
Nina (CS): quick flag — MediLabel onboarding p95 jumped from ~600ms to ~1300ms over 48h on /v1/chat. Renewal in 9 days. Thinking a low-risk perf hedge: route short responses to redwood-curie-5B-quant and keep gpu-13B for long docs. want a 6h canary + small offline QA against clinician_shortform_suite.

Lee (Solutions): can you share p50/p95 and a representative prompt? i want to model token cost and expected quality delta.

Nina (CS): p50=320ms, p95=1300ms, avg payload ~90 tokens (but long docs ~350-600). sample prompt: "Summarize the patient's vitals and note urgent follow-ups." historically curie-quant stayed in-range on short summaries but we need a fresh run.

Kai (SRE): any correlation with cold KV caches or nightly bulk imports?

Nina (CS): spikes around 01:18 UTC and 14:05 UTC — looks like batch ingestion AND a spike in concurrent preview requests. routing should smooth the tail.

Lee (Solutions): proposed plan: 1) offline eval on clinician_shortform_suite (metrics: entity-F1, ROUGE, hallucination flags); 2) create routing rule: match length<=800 tokens -> prefer redwood-curie-5B-quant, else gpu-13B; 3) canary 12% for 6h with auto-rollback if feedback_rate>1.5% in 20m or automated hallucination>1%; 4) collect free-text flags.

Ava (Customer): we can enable a feedback toggle for clinicians; please require a short reason (style/missing-info/incorrect). auto-rollback is required for clinician flows.

Kai (SRE): will stand up the canary and wire rollback. setting thresholds: feedback_threshold=0.015, analysis_window=20m. also temporarily cap bulk-import concurrency during test windows.

Lee (Solutions): routing snippet for Redwood Console (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
rules:
  - name: curie-short-pref
    match: request.tokens <= 800 and route.path == "/v1/chat"
    prefer: redwood-curie-5B-quant
    fallback: gpu-13B
    canary_percent: 12
    window: 6h
```

Nina (CS): assigning: @Lee run eval + A/B diff and post artifacts; @Kai run canary infra + auto-rollback; @Ava enable feedback widget + survey. i'll add a short note to the renewal packet describing the mitigation and CTA.

OpsBot: Canary launched -> canary-8162223334. Observability: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8162223334

Kai (SRE): canary live. initial streaming: canary p95=460ms, baseline p95=1280ms. quick 25-sample QA: phrasing differences in 5/25, no entity errors. feedback widget enabled.

Lee (Solutions): preliminary estimates: p95 reduction ~64% on routed short requests, token-cost delta for those requests ~-45%. if offline eval shows <2% entity-F1 drop and hallucination within guardrail we'll ramp to 50% over 24h.

Ava (Customer): clinicians enabled feedback. 3 flagged items so far (all style). survey responses submitted. will escalate immediately if any incorrect meds.

Kai (SRE): auto-rollback not triggered. feedback rate 0.8% over first 2h. continuing to stream metrics to renewal channel.

Nina (CS): will bundle eval artifacts + flagged examples into the renewal brief and update the renewal slide deck. will post final canary summary after 6h window. :white_check_mark:
